token.description:
The title "Butterflies and Clouds Don't Taste the Same" can be seen as a metaphor for the human experience of impermanence and the fleeting nature of pleasure, beauty and existence. The phrase “same flavor” implies a sense of unity and shared essence, which is precisely what is missing between butterflies and clouds.

Butterflies, as a symbol, can represent the fleeting nature of human life, beauty and pleasure. They are delicate, fragile and ephemeral, but they bring joy and wonder to those who experience them. In this sense, they can be seen as a manifestation of the impermanence of all things, including human existence.

Clouds, on the other hand, can symbolize the unpredictable and ever-changing nature of life. They constantly change shape, transform and reform, never staying the same for long. This can be seen as a reflection of the human experience of uncertainty, impermanence and the constant flux of life.

The fact that they “do not have the same flavor” suggests that these two aspects of existence – the ephemeral and the unpredictable – are fundamentally incompatible. This incompatibility can be seen as a reflection of the human condition, in which we struggle to reconcile our desire for permanence and stability with the reality of impermanence and change.

This dichotomy can be seen as a manifestation of the ancient Greek concept of the "human condition", where humanity is caught between the Apollonian desire for order, structure and permanence and the Dionysian forces of chaos, change and unpredictability.


1920 x 1080 / HD mp4 / 45 s / 21,6 Mo 
a subrealist reread based on the oil painting masterpiece by : 

William Quiller Orchardson - The first cloud 


Original works On view at : National Gallery of Victoria, Melbourne

token.description: The Dermaptera serves as a compelling symbol of the interplay between the hidden and the known. Its bizarre appearance and secretive habits embody the uncanny and the subconscious, transforming the mundane into the extraordinary. In contrast, its intricate design and functional morphology reflect nature's meticulous order and beauty. Thus, the Dermaptera bridges these philosophical realms, challenging perceptions while inviting admiration, encapsulating the complex dance between reality and imagination, the seen and the unseen.
token.name: Dermaptera
